common.disclaimer: NurtureLink is for monitoring and screening, not diagnosis.

split.empty: Select one to see its detail.

emptyState.title: Nothing here yet
emptyState.body: This part of NurtureLink is still being built. Please check back soon.

field.dobHint: We use this to check whether a parent or guardian also needs to agree.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to your NurtureLink account.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: For pregnant patients. Healthcare providers need an invite code instead.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
signup.minorNote: You are under 18, so a parent or guardian will also be asked to agree. You can still create your account.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If {{email}} can be used for a new account, we have sent it a link. Open the link to confirm your account, then log in.
checkEmail.sameBrowser: Please open the link in this same browser. It may take a few minutes to arrive. Check your spam folder too.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If there is an account for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Your link worked. Enter a new password below.
reset.invalid: This reset link is not valid any more. It may have expired, been used already, or been opened in a different browser. Please ask for a new one.

invite.title: Provider invite
invite.subtitle: Enter the code you were given to turn this account into a provider account.
invite.needAccount: To use an invite code, first create an account or log in. Then enter your code.

admin.title: Project owner account
admin.body: This is the admin account. Admin tasks are done in the Supabase SQL Editor, not in this app. Use a patient or provider account to try the app.

item.fallback: This item is not available in {{wanted}} yet. It is shown in {{shown}}.

gate.title: Before you start
gate.intro: Please read each item and tick its box to agree. You need to agree to every required item to use NurtureLink.
gate.languageHint: The text follows the language you pick with the EN | FIL button at the top.
gate.updated: Some documents have changed. Please read and accept the new versions.
gate.languageChanged: You changed the language, so the boxes were cleared. Please tick them again so that what we save matches the text you read.
gate.optionalHint: This item is optional. You can use NurtureLink without it.

exit.title: Not ready to agree?
exit.body: You can log out at any time using the button at the top. You can also ask us to delete your data.

loadError.title: We could not load the documents

unavailable.title: The documents are not ready yet
unavailable.body: NurtureLink cannot ask for your agreement yet because the documents have not been published. Please tell the project owner, then try again.

delete.title: Request data deletion
delete.body: You can ask us to delete your account and the data linked to it. The project team reviews each request, and you can follow its status here.

status.pending: Your request is waiting for review.

delete.pendingNote: You already have a request waiting. You do not need to send another.

modal.title: Ask us to delete your data?
modal.warning: If your data is deleted, you lose your account, your readings and your history in NurtureLink. This cannot be undone. Some records may have to be kept if the law requires it.
modal.noteLabel: Anything you want us to know (optional)
modal.noteHint: Please do not write health details here. Up to 1000 characters.

profile.privacyHint: What you agreed to, a copy to download, withdrawing, and data deletion
profile.intro: Your pregnancy details, health record, devices and settings.

preg.title: Pregnancy details
preg.intro: Add your due date and a few short notes. Your assigned provider, if you have one, can see these details. The app works out your weeks from the due date as an estimate. It is not a medical assessment.
preg.dueDateHint: Use the date your health provider gave you.
preg.duePast: This date is more than 2 weeks in the past. Please check it with your provider.
preg.dueAhead: This date is more than 40 weeks away. Please check it.

ga.title: Weeks of pregnancy
ga.unset: Add your due date to see this.
ga.beforeStart: This due date is more than 40 weeks away. Please check it.
ga.over42: More than 42 weeks. Please check the due date with your provider or health facility.
ga.pastDue: Your due date has passed. Please check with your provider or health facility.
ga.explain: Shown as completed weeks and days, counted from the due date. This is an estimate worked out by the app. Your provider may count differently.

preg.historyHint: Short notes only, for example earlier pregnancies. Up to {{max}} characters.
preg.historyBad: Please remove special or hidden characters from the notes. Line breaks are fine.
preg.historyLong: The notes are too long. Please keep them to {{max}} characters or fewer.
preg.conditionsHint: Add each condition separately. Up to {{max}} conditions, each up to {{len}} characters.
preg.condBad: Please remove special or hidden characters, or line breaks.
preg.condLong: Each condition can be up to {{len}} characters.
preg.condDuplicate: That condition is already in the list.
preg.condFull: You can add up to {{max}} conditions.
preg.loadFailed: We could not load your pregnancy details just now.

name.title: Display name
name.intro: Optional. Your assigned provider may see this name. You choose it, and it is not checked or verified.
name.label: Name
name.hint: Up to {{max}} characters. Leave it empty and save to remove it.
name.bad: Please remove special or hidden characters, or line breaks.

timeline.title: Health record timeline
timeline.intro: Baby heart-rate checks, alerts and appointments in one list, newest first. Times are in Philippine time.
timeline.limited: Older items may not be listed here. The Monitor, Alerts and Care tabs show more.
timeline.partial: Some items could not be loaded, so this list may be incomplete.
timeline.loadFailed: The timeline could not be loaded just now.

device.title: Your devices
device.loadFailed: Your devices could not be loaded just now.
device.reported: Battery and last-seen time are reported by your app. They are not verified.
device.pairingBody: Pairing a belt or wrist band will be added in a later version. Nothing is needed from you for now.

help.title: Help
help.manualBody: A short guide to using NurtureLink will be added here.
help.videosBody: Short demo videos will be added here.

account.title: Language and account
account.languageHint: Your language choice is saved to your account.

privacy.title: Privacy and consent
privacy.subtitle: See what you agreed to, download a copy, withdraw a consent, or ask us to delete your data.

accepted.title: What you agreed to
accepted.empty: You have not agreed to any documents yet.

record.textUnavailable: The text of this version is not available any more.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your consent?
withdraw.warningRequired: If you withdraw this, NurtureLink stops working for you. Monitoring, alerts and sharing your readings with your provider stop. You will go straight to the consent screen, and you can use the app again only after you agree again.
withdraw.warningStudy: We will stop using your anonymized data for the study from now on. Data that was already combined into results may not be possible to take out. The rest of NurtureLink keeps working.

study.title: Study data (optional)
study.off: You have not agreed to this. It is optional.
study.done: Thank you. Your agreement was saved.

download.title: Download a copy
download.body: Save a text file with your consent history: what you agreed to, which version, in which language, and when.

file.title: NurtureLink: my consent record
file.draftNote: Some of these documents are DRAFT texts that are still waiting for ethics and legal review.
file.none: You have not agreed to any documents yet.

status.okBody: Your latest check is within the usual range.
status.noBelt: There is no baby heart-rate check yet. Press Check now to see your status here.
status.stale: There has been no baby heart-rate check in the last {{hours}} hours, so we cannot show a status. Your last check was on {{date}}.

reason.sos_open: Your SOS alert is still open.
reason.alert_open: An alert is open. You can see it in the Alerts tab.
reason.signal_lost: The belt did not get a clear signal on your last check. Check the belt position and try again.
reason.fhr_out_of_range: Your last baby heart-rate reading was outside the usual range.
reason.low_spo2: Your last oxygen (SpO2) reading was lower than usual.
reason.fever: Your last temperature reading was higher than usual.

guidance.emergency: If you feel unwell or are worried about your baby, call local emergency services or go to a health facility now.
guidance.contactProvider: If you are worried, contact your provider.
guidance.providerMayNotSee: Your provider can see urgent alerts in the app but may not see them right away. Do not wait for a reply.
guidance.noProvider: You have no provider assigned yet, so no one else will see this. If you are worried, contact a health facility.

noProvider.title: No provider assigned yet
noProvider.body: Your checks are saved, but no provider is watching them and no provider will see your alerts. To be linked with a provider, ask your clinic or the project team.

fhr.title: Baby's heart rate
fhr.signalLost: No clear signal on this check. Check the belt position and try again.

check.note: For now this saves a simulated check. Checks with the real belt come later.

device.title: Your devices
device.none: No device is paired yet. Pairing will be added in a later version.

sos.title: Need help now?
sos.guidance: In an emergency, call local emergency services or go to the nearest health facility. Do not wait for this app.
sos.confirmBody: This sends an urgent alert to your provider in this app. It does not call anyone, and your provider may not see it right away.
sos.noProviderBody: You have no provider assigned yet, so this app cannot send an alert to anyone.
sos.unknownBody: We could not check whether you have a provider assigned, so this app cannot send an alert right now.
sos.sent: Your SOS alert was sent to your provider in this app. This does not call anyone. If you are in danger, call local emergency services or go to a health facility now.
sos.failedAdvice: If you are in danger, do not wait: call local emergency services or go to a health facility.

empty.title: No checks yet
empty.body: When you press Check now on the Home tab, or save a reading by hand below, your charts and history will appear here.

chart.none: Nothing was recorded in this time range.
chart.lost: Checks with no signal: {{count}}. They are shown as gaps, never as a line.
chart.failed: The chart could not be loaded. Your history and manual entry below still work.
chart.truncated: Only the newest 1000 entries in this time range are shown.

band.default: Shaded area: normal range {{range}}. This is a default limit that a medical officer has not confirmed yet.
band.none: No normal range is set for this measure, so no shaded area is shown.
band.unavailable: The normal range could not be loaded, so no shaded area is shown.

legend.gap: Gap: no signal, or no check for a long time

belt.title: Adjust the belt
belt.intro: Your recent checks had a weak or lost signal (latest check: {{date}}). These steps often help:
belt.step1: Rest for a minute. Sit or lie back comfortably and stay still while the belt checks.
belt.step2: Make sure the belt sensor touches your bare skin. The belt should be snug, not tight.
belt.step3: Move the sensor a little to another spot on your belly, then wait a few seconds.
belt.step4: Check that the belt is charged and connected.
belt.step5: Press Check now on the Home tab to try again.
belt.worried: If you are worried about your baby, do not wait for the app. Contact your provider or go to a health facility.

manual.title: Enter a reading by hand
manual.intro: Use this if your belt or wrist band is offline or not working.
manual.selfReported: Readings typed by hand are self-reported. The app cannot check them, and they are less reliable than a reading from the belt. They are saved with the time you press Save.
manual.reviewBody: You cannot change or delete a reading after it is saved. Please check the numbers.
manual.partial: Your baby's heart rate was saved, but your own values were not. Press Save reading again to finish. Nothing will be saved twice.
manual.outOfRange: A value you entered is outside the normal range. The app may alert your provider if this continues. It does not replace a check by a health professional. If you are worried, contact your provider or a health facility.
manual.errRange: Please enter a value between {{min}} and {{max}}.

alerts.intro: Alerts the app recorded from your checks. They are screening notes, not a diagnosis.
alerts.timeNote: Times are shown in Philippine time.

live.paused: Live updates are paused. This list will refresh every 30 seconds until the connection returns.
live.stale: We could not refresh just now. The list below may be out of date.

contact.title: Contact your provider
contact.placeholder: Chat with your provider is not available yet. It will arrive in a later update.
contact.noProviderBody: No provider will see your alerts yet. If you are worried, go to or contact your nearest health facility. In an emergency, call local emergency services now.
contact.unknownBody: We could not check whether you have a provider assigned. If you are worried, contact your nearest health facility. In an emergency, call local emergency services now.

list.title: Your alerts
list.emptyOpen: There are no open alerts right now.
list.emptyHandled: There are no handled alerts yet.

text.fhr: Your last {{readings}} baby heart-rate checks in a row were outside the app's usual range of {{min}} to {{max}} bpm. The most recent was {{value}} bpm.
text.fhrShort: A baby heart-rate check was outside the app's usual range.
text.signalLoss: The belt did not get a clear signal on your last {{readings}} checks in a row. Check the belt position and try again.
text.signalLossShort: The belt did not get a clear signal on your recent checks. Check the belt position and try again.
text.spo2: Your last {{readings}} oxygen (SpO2) readings in a row were lower than the app's usual minimum of {{min}} %. The most recent was {{value}} %.
text.spo2Short: An oxygen (SpO2) reading was lower than usual.
text.fever: Your last {{readings}} temperature readings in a row were higher than the app's usual maximum of {{max}} °C. The most recent was {{value}} °C.
text.feverShort: A temperature reading was higher than usual.

status.handledOn: Your provider marked this as handled on {{date}}.
status.resolvedOn: Your provider marked this as resolved on {{date}}.

seen.note: Marking an alert as seen does not close it or change its status.

sos.title: SOS history
sos.note: An SOS alert is shown to your provider in this app. It does not call anyone, and your provider may not see it right away.
sos.empty: You have not sent any SOS alerts.
sos.unavailable: SOS history could not be loaded just now.
sos.openGuidance: This SOS is still open. Do not wait for a reply. If you are in danger, call local emergency services or go to a health facility now.

care.intro: Ask for an appointment and see your appointments here.
care.timeNote: Times are shown in Philippine time.

provider.title: Your provider
provider.noName: Your provider's name is not shown yet.
provider.note: Your provider can see your appointment requests in this app but may not see them right away.
provider.unknown: We could not check whether you have a provider assigned, so appointment requests are paused for now.

noProvider.title: No provider assigned yet
noProvider.body: Appointment requests need a provider. To be linked with a provider, ask your clinic or the project team. If you are worried, contact a health facility.

request.title: Request an appointment
request.hint: Choose a date and time at least {{minutes}} minutes from now and no more than {{days}} days ahead. Philippine time.
request.durationNote: Each appointment is planned for {{minutes}} minutes.
request.disabled: You cannot request an appointment until a provider is assigned.
request.disabledUnknown: Requests are paused until we can check your provider.
request.sent: Your request was sent. It is not confirmed until your provider confirms it.
request.reminder: A request is not confirmed until your provider confirms it. Your provider may not see it right away, so do not wait for a reply if you are worried.

note.requestedNoProvider: No provider is linked to this request, so no one will confirm it. You can cancel it.
note.scheduled: Your provider confirmed this time. To change a confirmed time, cancel it and request a new time.
note.notConfirmed: This time passed without a confirmation.

cancel.title: Cancel this appointment?
cancel.requestedBody: This request will be marked as cancelled.
cancel.confirmedBody: This releases the time slot. Your provider will see the visit as cancelled.

change.title: Change the time
change.body: Choose a new date and time for this request. It is not confirmed until your provider confirms it.
change.done: The new time was saved. It is not confirmed until your provider confirms it.

tele.title: Chat and video visits
tele.body: Chat and video visits with your provider are planned for a later update. They are not available yet. For now, request an appointment here or contact your health facility.

history.title: Consult history
history.body: Your past consults will be listed here in a later update.

overview.timesNote: Times are shown in Philippine time.
overview.livePaused: Live updates paused. This list refreshes every 30 seconds.
overview.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed just now. You are seeing the last list that loaded.
overview.selectPatient: Select a patient from the list.

sos.title: SOS open
sos.note: The app does not show whether anyone has responded yet.

alerts.title: Open alerts
alerts.seenNote: “Patient has seen this” is for information only. It does not mean the alert has been handled.

triage.title: Patients by priority
triage.nameNote: Names are typed by the patients and are not verified. Use the ID to tell patients apart.

missed.title: Missed checks
missed.draftNote: A missed check means no belt check was recorded recently. This rule is a draft, pending the medical officer.

empty.title: No patients assigned yet
empty.body: When patients are assigned to you, they will appear here.

placeholder.title: Patient details
placeholder.body: This is a placeholder. Patient details will be added in a later version. No patient data is shown here yet.

type.fhr_out_of_range: Baby heart rate outside the app's range

errors.email_invalid: That does not look like an email address. Please check it.
errors.dob_required: Please enter your date of birth.
errors.dob_invalid: Please enter a real date of birth.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email or password is not right. Please try again.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox for our message.
errors.account_exists: We could not create that account. If you already have one, try logging in or resetting your password.
errors.weak_password: That password is too easy to guess. Please try a longer one with more variety.
errors.same_password: Please choose a password that is different from your old one.
errors.rate_limit: Too many tries just now. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.email_rate_limit: Only a few emails can be sent each hour. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.offline: We cannot reach the server. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.no_profile: We could not find your profile. Please log out and create your account again, or tell the project owner.
errors.not_eligible: This account already has a provider or admin role, so a code is not needed.
errors.invalid_invite: That code did not work. It may be wrong, already used, expired, or meant for a different email. Please check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.role_change_not_allowed: Account roles cannot be changed from the app.
errors.permission_denied: This account is not allowed to do that. If you think it should be, this is a setup problem, not something you did wrong. Please tell the project owner.
errors.not_configured: The app is not connected to its database yet. Please tell the project owner.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell the project owner.
errors.link_expired: The link in the email has expired or was already used. Please log in, or ask for a new link.
errors.link_invalid: The link in the email did not work. Please log in, or ask for a new link.
errors.profile_title: We could not load your account
errors.language_not_saved: Your language choice could not be saved to your account. It still works on this device.
errors.email_not_authorized: Our email service cannot send to this address yet. Please tell the project owner.
errors.reading_time_in_future: The time on this reading is ahead of the real time, so it was not saved. Please check that your device's date and time are correct, then try again.
errors.sos_rate_limited: Your SOS was already sent a moment ago, so a second one was not added. If you are in danger, call local emergency services or go to a health facility now.
errors.manual_reading_invalid: That reading could not be saved because a value looks wrong. Please check the numbers and try again.
errors.too_many_readings: A lot of readings were saved in the last hour, so saving is paused for now. Please try again in a little while. If you think this is a mistake, tell your provider.
errors.no_provider: You do not have a provider assigned yet, so an appointment cannot be requested here. To be linked with a provider, ask your clinic or the project team.
errors.appointment_time_invalid: Please choose a date and a time.
errors.appointment_too_soon: That time is too soon or has already passed. Please choose a time a little later.
errors.appointment_too_far: That time is too far ahead. Please choose an earlier date.
errors.too_many_open_requests: You already have several requests waiting. To make a new one, cancel one of them or wait until one is confirmed or its time has passed.
errors.appointment_not_changed: This appointment can no longer be changed here. It may already be cancelled, confirmed or past. The list has been refreshed.
errors.display_name_invalid: That name cannot be saved. Please remove special or hidden characters or line breaks, and shorten the name if it is long.
errors.due_date_out_of_range: That due date cannot be saved. Please check that the date is right.
errors.history_invalid: The history notes cannot be saved. Please remove special or hidden characters, and shorten the notes if they are long.
errors.conditions_invalid: The conditions cannot be saved. Please remove special or hidden characters, shorten long entries and keep the list short.
